## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-eldorado-eval-results`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-eldorado-eval-results -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `data/measurements.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `data/measurements.json`
- `data/measurements.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/eldorado-eval-results at revision `e063d7b5f2379b64eaaffd3f5ad4df88c2e385e3`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# Eldorado — signed measurement receipts

Signed measurement receipts. Each row of `data/measurements.jsonl` carries the
`registry` the measurement was taken against, the `subject` model and its `subject_digest`, the
`measured_count` out of `total_count` and the resulting `ratio`, a `content_hash` over the payload, the
`receipt_content_id`, the `anchor_time`, and the DID that signed it
(`did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1`). A ratio here is coverage of a registry, not an axis score.

## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `data/measurements.json` | 2580 |  | JSON document |
| `data/measurements.jsonl` | 2302 | 1 | data (one JSON object per line) |
| `README.md` | 1504 |  | card |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 4 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.jsonl` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
